column5: What if you stopped drinking water?
You've lost one percent of your body weight in water.
Your kidneys switch to survival mode.
Your body is running out of time.
Most people can't last much longer.
In nineteen seventy-nine, an eighteen-year-old was locked in a police cell in Austria.
He licked drops off the walls… and survived about eighteen days.
Even right now, you're losing water… with every breath.
